200.title: NATO stands with Poland, says Rutte after Russia violates its airspace
200.summary: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte has said the whole military alliance stands with Poland after Russian missiles struck inside the country on Friday. Rutte was visiting Warsaw in a show of NATO unity following an airspace incursions on Friday morning in which a Russian Kh-101 cruise missile and two other objects, believed to be a missile and jet-powered drone, struck inside Poland.
200.body: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte has said the whole military alliance stands with Poland after Russian missiles struck inside the country on Friday. Rutte was visiting Warsaw in a show of NATO unity following an airspace incursions on Friday morning in which a Russian Kh-101 cruise missile and two other objects, believed to be a missile and jet-powered drone, struck inside Poland. Although Polish officials requested additional NATO forces and air-defense capabilities following the incidents, Warsaw stopped short of invoking the alliance’s Article 4, which provides for consultations between allies in the event that a member considers its security threatened, ISW pointed out. “NATO risks raising the real threshold for allied responses to blatant Russian violations of NATO airspace by failing to use the alliance’s provisions for collective action in response to intentional attacks,” the ISW wrote.

300.title: FedEx and three finance firms complete $8.5 billion buyout of Polish parcel company
300.summary: A four-company consortium of parcel giant FedEx and three investment firms has completed its previously announced $8.5 billion acquisition of InPost, a Polish provider of e-commerce parcel delivery services.
300.body: A four-company consortium of parcel giant FedEx and three investment firms has completed its previously announced $8.5 billion acquisition of InPost, a Polish provider of e-commerce parcel delivery services. The buyers included: the private equity firm Advent International, L.P.; the Czech investment group PPF Group; FedEx Corp. through its subsidiary FCWB LLC; and A&R Investments Ltd.—a financial entity founded by InPost CEO Rafał Brzoska. InPost operates an out-of-home network of over 100,000 locations, comprising more than 70,000 automated parcel lockers and close to 30,000 pick-up and drop-off points. InPost says it is aiming to redefine the European e-commerce sector by improving the delivery experience for consumers and merchants alike, supported by the new ownership consortium’s accelerated investment in InPost’s digital offering and consumer experience, including its mobile app.
